name: Banh da ca ro dong
summary: Bánh đa cá rô đồng is a rice cracker with field climbing perch. The 15 February 2023 culture page says you eat it with green mustard greens.
origin: Ninh Bình. The page does not pin a commune. A 2024 tourism article names cá rô Tổng Trường for Hoa Lư, which is a different name.
howToEat: Eat the cracker with rau cải xanh, as Sở Văn hóa và Thể thao says.
where: Not pinned on the 2023 page. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh da ca ro dong — cracker and perch
seoDescription: Rice cracker with field climbing perch and green mustard, from the 15 February 2023 page.
